description: This file declares functions related to device types within the c10 namespace, including device type naming, validation, stream output, backend registration, and backend querying. It also includes typedefs and using declarations for device type management.

methods.name: DeviceTypeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified device type, optionally in lowercase.

methods.name: isValidDeviceType
methods.description: Checks whether the provided device type is valid.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads the stream insertion operator to output a DeviceType object.

methods.name: register_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Registers a backend for private use 1 with the given backend name.

methods.name: get_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Returns the name of the privateuse1 backend, optionally in lowercase.

methods.name: is_privateuse1_backend_registered
methods.description: Checks whether the privateuse1 backend has been registered.
